title: Frog holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Frog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#A5D6A7'/>
  <!-- Left eye bump -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='42' r='12' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- Right eye bump -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='42' r='12' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- Left eye white -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='40' r='8' fill='#E8F5E9'/>
  <!-- Right eye white -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='40' r='8' fill='#E8F5E9'/>
  <!-- Left pupil -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='40' r='4' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <!-- Right pupil -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='40' r='4' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <!-- Left eye shine -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='38' r='2' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <!-- Right eye shine -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='38' r='2' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <!-- Mouth smile -->
  <path d='M38 52 Q50 62 62 52' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d='M22 64 Q16 58 20 50' stroke='#4CAF50' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d='M78 64 Q84 58 80 50' stroke='#4CAF50' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left hand -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='48' r='5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- Right hand -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='48' r='5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <g transform='translate(50 38)'>
    <path d='M0 6 C-2 -2 -10 -4 -10 2 C-10 8 0 16 0 16 C0 16 10 8 10 2 C10 -4 2 -2 0 6 Z' fill='#FF4081'/>
    <!-- Heart shine -->
    <ellipse cx='-3' cy='2' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#FF80AB' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Left leg -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='88' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- Right leg -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='88' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- Spots on head -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='2' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='54' r='4' fill='#81C784' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='54' r='4' fill='#81C784' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
